# Use actions

This page describes how to create Terraform Developer Portal actions and attach them to Terraform Developer Portal templates and applications. Platform engineers often perform these tasks. Refer to [Actions](/hcp/docs/waypoint/concepts/actions) for additional information.

## Prerequisites

- An HCP account with Terraform Developer Portal enabled. Refer to [HCP Account](/hcp/docs/hcp/create-account) for information about creating an account.



## View action run history for an application

To view an action's run history for an application, complete the following steps:

1. Sign into the [HCP portal](https://portal.cloud.hashicorp.com/) and click **Waypoint** in the **Services** menu.
1. Click **Applications** in the sidebar, then click on the name of an application.
1. Click **Action runs** in the sidebar.

## Next steps

To learn more about what you can do with Terraform Developer Portal after you created an action, refer to the following topics:
